company_info.company_description: "My Energy Group’s vision is to become the leader in the renewable energy and energy efficiency industry with the most affordable cost and the most reliable service.My Energy Group is a national provider of solar power and LED lighting solutions from residential home owners to full-scale commercial systems. In what has now become one of the fastest growing industries, we pride ourselves on our understanding of the latest technologies while providing affordable, quality products with service that cannot be beaten.At My Energy, we are aiming to make a positive difference to the clients, environment, and society in whatever we do; with a combined experience of 50 years within the industry."

reviews.review_description: I had a good experience with my MyEnergy installation and had recommended to a couple of friends. I noticed that one of my panels had stopped producing power a couple of years post install and contacted the company who diagnosed a faulty optimiser and ordered the part - I was informed it arrived months ago and was copied into a request to get a technician to come and install. Their service team is yet to acknowledge a single email and despite calling and being promised a call back - nothing. Would not recommend now, I feel like my warranty is worthless without a decent service department backing it up.
The whole procedure is easy to follow up and great customer service

The sales and quoting process was clear, efficient, and well-explained, with all technical details and costs presented transparently.The installation was carried out punctually and to a high standard. The team was polite, tidy, and worked efficiently, ensuring that the site was left clean and organised upon completion.Customer service was excellent. The team assisted with the grid connection process after installation and provided clear guidance on system operation, including the use of the charger.Overall, the project was delivered smoothly and professionally, with all aspects meeting a high standard.

Really happy with my new solar and battery setup. The quoting process was simple and straightforward, no pushy sales tactics, just clear info. The installers showed up on time, were super polite, and left everything neat and tidy. After the install, the team walked me through the app and even sorted out the grid connection, which saved me a lot of hassle. The Anker Solix 30kWh battery has been running smoothly and I’m already seeing the benefits. Definitely recommend!
Great product, professional skill, nice customer services and very genius people
Good service and beatiful productI can easy manage the system by app

We engaged MyEnergy Group to install our new Anker Solix X1 6kW / 20kWh battery at Southwest Sydney, and the experience was excellent from start to finish. We had a specific request to wall-mount the battery on our entertainment deck as a feature piece. The sleek grey matte finish looks incredible in the space, but with limited wall area, it was a tricky installation.Jeff from MyEnergy Group took the time to visit our home, walk through different layout options, and find a design that worked within the constraints, all while ensuring full compliance. No shortcuts, no hesitation.Kent led the installation, and the result is nothing short of professional. The work is neat, tidy, and carefully planned. He and the team were very accommodating in setting up essential circuit backups (fridge, kitchen, NBN), and they took the time to ensure the cabling was clean and discreet.Check out the photos — the craftsmanship speaks for itself. You can tell they take pride in their work. We’re stoked with the outcome and glad we chose MyEnergy Group for the job!
Great product done by professional installer, easy process, great customer service

The sales and quoting process was clear and professional. My Energy Group provided a detailed quote with a breakdown of costs and system specifications. The representative answered all questions promptly and offered additional information when requested. There was no high-pressure sales tactics.The installation team arrived on time and completed the work within the scheduled timeframe. They were polite, professional, and maintained a tidy worksite, ensuring minimal disruption.The Anker battery is the top notch product that we can source from the market, slim deisgn with solid build quality and the background of the company also provide us the confidence for long term support.Overall, My Energy Group delivered a smooth and professional experience from initial quote to installation and post-install support. The process was well-managed, and the team demonstrated competence and courtesy throughout.

Installers initially came unannounced and dismantled to old system then suddenly packed up and went away. Apparently they had come to the wrong address.  We were left with no solar for two weeks when they came again and fixed everything up in a day.  All working well,  However they left the old panels which they said they would take away.  These were subsequently collected after holding back final payment.  Otherwise system working well.  Problems may be use of subcontractors and communication issues.
Easy process from quote to installation.Sales process easy.Installation seamless.
Thomas from MyEnergy came out for site visit quickly . He was always transparent and followed up everything to ensure all ok. Recommended

Had a great experience from the start with Ash from My Energy Group, he sat with me for over an hour and explained everything we needed to know about solar. He took the time to answer my follow up emails and calls and was generous with his time.The only hiccup in the process was at installation. During the quoting process Ash recommended installing the panels landscape instead of portrait as it meant we only needed panels on three sections of roof and apparently results in a lower chance of cracking as there is less overhang that could pull up in strong winds. But once the installers arrived they told us they'd prefer to install portrait on four sections of roof and would need to remove the satellite to fit the panels. The installers were hesitant for me to call Ash to clarify and it turned out that it would have cost more to lay them landscape (as it's apparently more work).We eventually agreed to remove the satellite and lay the panels portrait (as a friend who works in solar said he didn't believe there to be a difference) and luckily the fourth panel of roof that had to be used isn't an eyesore. So in the end it was all fine but it was slightly disconcerting to be quoted one thing and the installer to change the plan on the day as it would have incurred an extra charge.We've only had the system a week so far so can't speak to it's longevity but so far so good! We're thrilled.

After having a 5/5 experience with Thomas from My Energy for my own home putting in a 13kw system, decided to get Thomas' help again for my parents' place for a 9kw system. Again, fantastic communication, assistance with workshopping the design to meet our specific needs, straightforward and hassle free process. Also worth mentioning, the team that did the installation were the same again and were absolutely amazing. Speedy, professional, cleaned up all the rubbish, and broke a total of only 2 tiles over both projects which is ridiculously good.

The sales/quoting process was excellent, very efficient and helpful as well being professional. The installation was done promptly and smooth, the technician was friendly and happy to guide me through the process.                                                       The customer service was great assured me that everything will be done and organised, he walked me through all the necessary process to my knowledge.

My Energy Group was fantastic throughout the process, from receiving a quote, working with me to amend the design slightly, organising installation, and follow up after installation. Thomas was responsive and knowledgeable and very helpful. The installers were also amazing, very prompt, high attention to detail and didn't leave a single piece of rubbish. Very neat installation. 5 star rating all round.

NB: We were buying 2 systems for 2 townhouses.  3 storey, flat roof, no access for a scissor lift. we made the salesperson very aware of any access difficulties.Sales process was fine. They explained the options and didn't try to over-sell us.They did mention, when asked, that the system would be "battery ready" but I didn't ask enough questions as to what this means and it turns out that a new inverter will be needed if I wish to add batteries.They did emphasise how good their installers were but did not mention that all their installation teams were sub-contractors.We were assured that installation would take 4-8 weeks.  The deposit was paid Nov '22. I estimated it would be done in February '23 at the latest.  The installation occurred in April '23, 21 weeks after the deposit was paid.In that 21 week period the sub-contractors all refused to take on the job.  The company failed to do their job and at one point claimed "It's not my job to organise this work" but could not tell me who had that job.At one point I was asked if I could supply a ladder so they could access the roof as none of their sub-contractors owned a suitable length ladder.  I told them they should hire or buy a ladder.When the installation occurred the sub-contractor said they would start at 8.00 but arrived at 10.00.  They consistently arrived late each day.Their truck looked like a rubbish dump with tools and parts thrown in the back.The 2 day installation took 4 days including a Sunday even though the tradesman said they weren't having any problems.  It was obvious that the 2 installers were fatigued and working quite slowly.They ran out of conduit and saddles.  I gave them supplies from my workshop.Despite all that the installation was neat and there haven't been any problems.When the company sent me photos of the installation they sent the wrong roof.  When questioned they couldn't find my roof photos.I can't recommend this company.

Yahiya from My Energy Group was always available when I needed his assistance. His  knowledge on this technical matter as well as his well formed explanations helped answer all my queries. My Energy Group should be proud to have such an amazing member who is able to perfectly explain and respond to all my questions.Manish quoted, discussed, and convinced me to get the right type of solar panels for my house. The company should also be proud to have him on board.If you plan to install Solar Panels to your home, don’t hesitate to contact My Energy Group as I am very pleased with the results.
Thomas is polite helpful sales guy, was punctual and the work was completed in a timely manner.After sales have also been helpful, job done with no fuss.
Salesman was very knowledgeable.Installation went pretty smoothly.Had to organise my own grid connection.The inverter installed did require a recall about a month later. All fixed now.

the whole process went fine, a very  patient sales person who was able to answer all my questions did a good job.and they did the installation on time. The system is working fine and our house can just make it through the night using the battery without anything from the grid.The system is generating way more power than we can use so it will be important to make sure we get a decent return on what we export.The only thing I had a bit of an issue with was that since the electrician had a very heavy accent we sometimes misunderstood each other

My install requirements were quite unique to say the least. Tom from MyEnergy came out and showed a lot of patience as we worked through several possible solutions over several weeks. I feel like we both worked quite hard to come up with a suitable way forward, I could have easily been thrown in the too hard basket.What I liked about MyEnergy was the support post installation. I had a minor issue which required a panel to be replaced, and thankfully there was no problems with this at all. The team were committed to delivering a solar and battery solution that I was satisfied with and this is where I think a business earns their stripes.I'm happy to recommend MyEnergy.

Everything was easy and straightforward from the first time we spoke weren’t pushy like others I had previously dealt with installation had no drama I had everything I needed for my electricity provider the day after installation would have no issues recommending my energy to anyone highly recommend.
Thomas was great he explained everything and was very helpful.Installers turned up on time and finished in a day .

Excellent service from Thomas - answered all my questions in a timely manner and explained things to me.After a few false starts and interruptions from rotten weather, the installation went really well - quick, efficient and friendly. The team worked hard and got the job done, and cleaned up after themselves.The grid connection was organised before I even got to contact my providerThe cover for the inverter and power box looks good and was much appreciated by an electrician who came this week in horrible weather for an unrelated matter

I carn't speak highly enough of the Team at my energy from sales to install youre knowledge help and guidance along with patience far out weighed my expectations from a solar company . Im so glad I chose you guys to fit my house out with solar . A special thank you to Thomas for always being there and answering my questions during the whole sale and install and putting me on the right path !
Sales and quoting was well done.Installation was excellent .Customer service was ordinary.

Just completed installation of my Solar through My Energy Group. The end to end process was outstanding. Ash from My Energy Group provided me with lots of guidance and options and was super helpful and always available to take my questions and helped design a solution that was right for me. The installation was great too, very tidy and professional. I would gladly recommend My Energy Group to anyone that asks!

Sales/quoting process was easy and receptive to changes to our needs/budget.Installation was scheduled in quickly and done without damage to the roof. Installers were polite and helpful (despite it being 39 degrees!).After install communications was good, documentation provided.
Tom was fantastic to deal with, the quote to install was super easy as to was the finance option.I’m now saving over $200 a month for a 4 bed house and wondering why I didn’t do this years ago!

Sales pieces was very helpful with person responding with answers to all my questions (I am the type of person who wants to know lots of detail). A few options were offered, with information on the advantages of each.Installation was done in a day (panels and battery). They arrived on time, and despite suggesting we have spare roof tiles in case of breakages, they didn’t break any.  We have only just had it installed, so still finalising the grid connection details, but that is being organised by the sales person.

The sales guy was knowledgeable and provided us with a range of quotes to meet our needs and budget.We were away the day the installation was done. On return everything was completed with clear instructions left for us.My Energy Group guided us through the process end to end. We are now enjoying the benefits of a quality solar system. Well done team.
The process was easy and answered all my questions no matter how many times I called.Installers were polite came when they said and tidy.

We have a partially shaded roof and wanted solar to offset pool costs.Tom designed a great system and quote to maximise the roof space and sun available.The installers were professional, clean and polite and too about 6 hours.We are enjoying the benefits now and savings!

Sales experience was great. Unfortunately, once the panels were installed we had issues.Sales process was great, with excellent planning and support through the process including revising the size of the installation.Issues began to occur once the payment was made.Firstly, of the three members of the install team, only one spoke English (and only a little). which was concerning as it made it hard to understand the process and to ask questions. There was no explanation of what they would and how they would do it.Once installed, we had issues with the inverter and consumption monitoring part of the Solar Edge app, which would intermittently drop out (sometimes for days at a time).This issue is yet to be rectified and getting a response from My Energy Group is difficult. We have had the installer come to check out the inverter but so far there is no resolution.Furthermore, we had an electrician look at the installation of the switch for the solar inverter on our circuit board and their view was that the switch was barley connected to the wiring and had not been well installed.I am happy with the sales process and panels, but the installation and after service support has really left a lot to be desired. Unfortunately, I would not go with this provider again.Update 22/3/2024: the metering issue is now resolved, this was an issue at Solar Edge’s end rather than MEG

MyEnergygroup only communicated via email and phone. They never visited property.  I was constantly following up on queries and issues experienced.I paid extra for black rails. Rails are black and all fixings are bright shiny silver so didn’t see the point of paying extra.I wanted the wiring internal to the wall cavity, this was made clear at the proposal stage and on the day of installation. Electrician advised it was illegal for him to install the wiring in a brick veneer wall. I took the advice on face value. With further investigation after the installation was complete I found this not to be true. There is some minimum distances to the surface that do need to be maintained (advised by solarquotes) but my wall cavity was well within compliance. It would appear the electrician lied to facilitate an easy install. The electrician never even entered the roof cavity to investigate.Brand new gutters have paint removed where they tied there ladders against.Installation date was set but installers never turned up. No call, no email to advise. I followed up and they advised due to weather conditions they didn’t attend.

I had some reservations about MyEnergy, for instance, the other 2 companies from which I had a quote attended personally, while MyEnergy was handled over the phone. However, their price was more competitive and it looked like their product was good quality (based on SolarQuotes YouTube videos). The government rebate differed in all three quotes (I investigated STCs!), but MyEnergy's rebate was higher. This seemed like a good sign that they passed on their STC value to the customer. Anyway, I got on very well with salesman Jawad and took the chance.Communication with the company was not the greatest and I had to chase up to get an installation date. Jawad, however, was always contactable and kept in touch and answered the several queries I had. Two days before that installation date I tried to get confirmation that it was happening (there'd been a lot of rain) to no avail. However, they turned up on the day as promised. The 22 panel installation was done in half a day, the battery, inverter and all electricals took the whole day.As for the grid connection, I was told by all companies that 'they would do the paperwork'. After installation, I decided to call my supplier (AGL) and check they were recognising the 'back to the grid' power. They hadn't been contacted by MyEnergy, but would set it up for me based on my call. A week later, after my full payment, MyEnergy sent me the 'paperwork' and advised me to contact my energy supplier. So, it appears, I had to do it after all. I called AGL, who advised me it was all set up and they didn't require that paperwork.The iSolarCloud app is giving me readings which appear odd sometimes, and I have sent in some queries to MyEnergy, and hope to get answers from them (they have confirmed receipt of my questions).Based on the cost, I think I have made the right decision (the next lowest quote was $7,000 more). The system design was based more on my budget than the other companies did.Top marks particularly to Jawad for his communication and attentiveness, before and after my signing up.
The sales representative was very knowledgeable and explained that we will save even more without having a battery

I am thrilled to share my outstanding experience with My Energy Group regarding the installation of my 6.6kW solar system featuring Longi panels and a GoodWe MS inverter. From the initial consultation to system commissioning, every aspect of this project has been handled with utmost professionalism and expertise.

Waited a long time for the Solar Edge Battery. But happy to say it performs as expected and as advertised. Solar Edge Battery is relatively new to market in Australia. There had been some mixed reviews regarding this battery. I had also been considering a Tesla Powerwall.We have had a 5kw Solar Edge inverter for almost 3 years and it has been very stable.It seemed logical to stay Solar Edge and add their battery. Andrew at My Energy Group offered a neat solution, incorporating extra solar panels, with a free upgrade to the 8.25kw Hybrid Solar Edge Inverter along with a 10kwh Solar Edge Battery and Backup.The only frustrating part was waiting almost 5 months for components to arrive. The installation by Michael and Team went flawlessly and the operation of the whole system has been seamless and exactly as advertised.We have been effectively’ off-grid’ now for the past 2 weeks. We no longer buy electricity, now only export. Our daily electricity bill is always negative... Having a battery is a game changer. Highly recommended.

Sales/quoting process - Renato is knowledgeable and recommended few good options to meInstallation - did went smoothly and they cleaned up after each installationCustomer service - very poor, i need to follow up on the battery installation. There was a delay (4-5 months) by the supplier but nobody bother to contact me or notify me of the delay. Feels like if i don't follow up the installation will just drag on. They also changed the battery installation date twice which i have to move my work meetings to be able to work from home. Not happy!

In 2021 my energy group installed a 28 panel system (Longi 370 W) with enphase IQ 7 micro inverters for us.It was great to deal with them prior the sale. That installation was done well and we are happy at the time. 4/5 stars.In regards to after-service: 0/5 stars: Absolutely poor.We have tried to contact the company in regards to a technical question and adding batteries and maybe a few more panels at the same time. We have sent several emails (over 10!) to various emails: info@myenergygroup.com.au and also some emails to the staff we had email contact when we installed our system. We also made phone calls.We received several replies that someone will be in touch, or that someone else will be contacting us. So far - over 6 months no genuine response - which is very dissapointing. So I would not recommend this company even the installation was good.

The sales process was smooth and the salesperson was much more knowledgeable than the others we got quotes from.They offered a system that was $4k cheaper than the competitors without compromising on quality.The installers were very professional and everything was installed without a glitch.
Excellent installation
The quoting process was smooth and quick, the contractor was professional through the installation process. The next day following up was very helpful all the answers were given and very thorough

Hello,  Ash from My Energy was the last to quote.  Came to site and was very pleasant and up front with the quote. Was happy to answer my questions and make adjustments.  No pressure from him in regards to the quote, or denigrating other companies.Customer service communicated via email, sms where required.  Arranged grid connection prior to booking an installation date.  and were able to accommodate my preferred date.   Consumption monitoring was included in the quoted.Installation was via contractors.  They were efficient, clean and polite while doing the job.
Friendly and helpful.Installers were polite even though they sometimes had difficulty with the English language.Excellent customer service.

Salesmen was convincing we got 2 other quotes. Installation took 3 days first day came around with wrong equipment.Salesman said we would get all this great info from their app but it turns out we can only get production info not even panel information since we have 30 optimizers so there is no way of telling if all 30 panels are working properly. This was very disappointing as I was really looking forward to monitoring the system, I feel like I have been misguided greatly in this.If I had of known I would not be getting any information I would not have gone with solaredge or myenergy group.

We had a great experience with My Energy Group. The salesperson was fantastic and was with us all the way through the process. Third party installers were curious and professional, although not strong in English which raised a concern if we had to discuss anything in detail (it went fine though).Only feedback would be that once we signed the contract it felt like we had to chase for updates on the process and where things were up to. Our sales rep was always available and assisted us through the process. Would certainly use My Energy Group again or recommend them.
Sales and installation were excellent however after sales has been lacking a little. Lucky I’ve got the sales guys mobile who moves things along

Sale person (Michael) was responsive and answer many questions I asked (over multiple email). Proposal was quite detail and Michael was able to answer question on the modelling they used. Project manager was good, provided all the documents for grid connection, also answer email quickly.  Installer (contractor) was punctual, good knowledge, end up saving me a few hundreds dollars, as he found enough space for consumption meters behind the main switchboard, so no need for optional board.  Only just got the meters changed to smart meters today, so can't tell how the economic works yet.

The sales process was good.The salesman inspected the site and was fully aware of site access issues (narrow path) and the height of the building (3 stories).The salesman did not try to over-sell and made recommendations that aligned with my quality expectations.He was not pushy and there was no pressure to sign up. He did make a big point of how responsive to customers needs they were.After signing the contract  and paying a deposit (22Nov2022) the problems started.We were told 6-8 weeks for installation with a possibility of a small delay due to labour problems.The next contact with My Energy Group (MEG) was 26 Jan2023 (9 weeks later) advising the installation was the 30thJan, a work day for me on such short notice.  The date was re-negotiated to 31Jan.During my conversations with the MEG project manager I repeatedly requested that they send a Team Leader prior to installation to inspect the site due to the access issues and height of building.  MEG said this wasn't needed.The installer arrived several hours later (mid-afternoon) than the appointed time of 9.00am.  They looked around and said "The access is too difficult.  We haven't got a ladder that high."  They left.Note that My Energy Group only use sub-contract installers.  This is an issue as the installers only want to do the easy jobs.I had several conversations with the MEG Project Manager and he appeared to be at a loss on how to move the project forward as the sub-contractors didn't want to do the job and didn't have suitable equipment.MEG then went silent for several weeks.  It was only when contacting the sales representative that we got some action.MEG then tried to back out of the contract without any compensation to go to another installer (prices had risen on the 01 Jan) saying the job was too difficult despite my pointing out the site access and height issues during the quote process.MEG then suggested that I hire a ladder for them as they didn't have a long ladder.  I refused.A new date for installation was agreed to in mid-April 2023. 5 months after paying the deposit.The installers arrived 3 hours later than advised.  The had a ladder.  It was broken.  I had to lend them rope to fix it.  I had to give them conduit saddles because they didn't have enough.It took 3 days to install two 15 panel systems.  They were unbelievably slow and appeared to be incredibly fatigued and overworked.I took unpaid time off work to give them site access. Fine for 1 day but 3 gets expensive.There are aspects of the installation that are poor in execution.In the after-installation process I asked for photos of the panels on the roof.  They sent photos of the wrong roof.  They had none of my installation.I could not recommend using My Energy Group, especially due to their exclusive use of contractors.NB: this is my 3rd solar PV install and the worst I've had to deal with.

Very slow very to start after paying a deposit and then made a mistake that they had to rectify before turning the system on, so more delay.Our system is actually 4.290 kW single phase. We have 13 x 330 W halfcut black frame/cell  13 x IQ7 Enphase microinverters with wi-fi set up.The mistake was that because we chose microinverters  there had to be an extra wire going from the meter box to another small fus box connected to the inverters.They didn't know that it had to be done and they took a long time to come back to rectify their mistake.

The supplier selected was mid-range in pricing from the suppliers (6) selected to quote. A lot of research went into systems prior to obtaining quotes. Price was not the main criteria for selection. The companies that only used Google Earth to quote were generally cheaper, but if you are not bothered to look at the site/meter how can you be sure there will be no additional costs. The installation team were very good and obliging. Their method of securing the frame ensured no holes in tiles or cracks.The only thing to monitor now is their payback calculations.
Sales and quoting was good.  Very efficient.  Good placement of solar panels.  The installers (contractors) were friendly, punctual and cleaned up afterwards which can be a rarity.

I had a really great salesperson who came to the site and designed the system to suit my needs. I have a lot of shade on the roof and most other companies did not properly take this into account when designing panel placement. MyEnergy spent the time to do the modelling and recommended a big system placed in an area of the roof others had not considered. The installation was later than promised (largely because of supply chain issues) but I was notified well ahead of time. The installation team were through, fast and explained the system to me in detail. I have followed up with MyEnergy post-installation about getting a heat pump hot water system and they were slow coming back to me - mainly specialising in commercial installation of these units. Otherwise all good.

From start to finish Kenwit from My Energy Group has been on the ball. Always fast to respond + delivered much needed guidance to the correct system for me. At no point was he 'salesy' - just seemed to want the best for me and my needs. Other quoter was just a greedy sales pitch and the other barely bother to even quote. Installation was on time + was performed by a hard working team that worked in super hot conditions to get the job done. They were all friendly, professional and clean. Thanks all!

Sales quoting process was fine.The sub-contracted installers were apparently technically good but spoke little English, and there have been ongoing WiFi connection issues, which seem to have been resolved today through the Inverter company, Sungrow's Help Desk.  Sungrow also replaced an apparently defective dongle on the Inverter, and helped me connect it to the WiFi.It only became apparent today that the inverter does not work with 5G WiFi.There was a insufficient after installation advice and support, provided by email.The best support was provided by Sungrow.
The entire process went very smoothly, from the quote through to the surprisingly quick install.

Great sales advice.Brilliant installersOrgnised the grid after install.Helpful after sales contact advice and care.As I am in the service industry myself I can highly recommend My Energy Group Pty Ltd.The whole experience was very professional  and honest.
All in one go, good price, hassle free, trouble free, works smoothly. Highly recommend.

Could work and improve on customer communication and transparency.The first impression was great, and quick turnaround from sales rep. However, communication between the(me) consumer and retailer took a turn after signing the deal/deposit paid. Had to go through solar quotes to chase up the retailer in order to obtain an update on where the process is up to - ie, no confirmation if the deposit was received, nor an application for grid has been submitted or what so ever.Was promised a Black Friday Deal / Offer -  To date ( 2 weeks after solar installation ) no correspondence or follow-up.Installation was - ok. Sub-contractors arrived late and finished the job at approx 6.30 pm. My new colourbond carport was scratched while installing the flexible conduits.

Great experience during quotation process. All my questions were answered and alternative systems were evaluated. Very happy with the system chosen. The installers arrived on time. Existing system was removed and new installation was smooth despite very threatening skies followed by torrential rain. Rather than leaving the site, the installers waited out the rain and completed installation the same day despite being held up by the terrible weather. The site was left tidy and grid connection organised before they left

Ken the salesperson was awesome to deal with, came up with multiple different options which allowed me to choose what i thought was the best bang for buckinstallation took longer than expected because we have a very steep roof so it would have been nice for the installers to come and see and confirm they can do the job before committing a date. had two scheduled installs cancelled because the installers arrived and saw how steep the roof was and said they could not do it, even though i told my energy group that we had a steep roofHowever, when we did get the installers come they did a fantastic job, completed all in one day, it was a very difficult install where we had panels on the N, E & W sides. they cleaned up after themselves and left no messAfter sales service was ok, got the papers within two days, could have communicated better about grid connection approval etc.overall, i am very happy with the install and the amount power it is generating. one thing to note, we have duel Huawei hybrid inverters and these really slow down the wifi/internet. Not sure how to fix that issue

I received a phone call from MYENERGY group sales desk the day after I required my 3 quotes from Solar QuotesThe sales person was very knowledgeable and offered me the best solutions and quotes from the other 2 solar companies.The second company didn't bother calling me but screen shot me his diary page probably too busy to make a phone call to a new customer. The third one texted me and called me to agree on a day and time for on site inspection, for which I took a morning off work. Two hours before the onsite visite I got a text message telling me he was under the weather and couldn't come. I wasn't happy with the situation. MYEnergy Group will get the contract.I contacted privately a fourth company ( the one which installed 2 years ago my 5 kWh Sungrow inverter and Canadian Solar panels ) . I was quoted a premium price for a premium system and no other solutions or offers.The installation dates and time was changed from someone without my conscent but I got it rectified after a few phone calls.The installer turned up on time and removed my 10 years + old legacy Eco 2000 1.5 KWh system as per our agreement.However I wasn't impressed by the 2 tradies, one having a few smokos while working on my double storey roof  and both men not wearing any harness at all ? The tradies didn't clean the gutter after leaving, I found 2 big brackers and a lot of small roof screws left behind.In my garage I found 2 pieces of conducts on the floor.Overall the installation took a little over 5 hours, The electrician was competent organising my 5G wireless internet connection to be split between the two frequencies 2.4 and 5 GHz to enable the 4 G connection to the SEMS portal to work.I was shown how to operate the App to monitor the Solar System.I'm very happy with my 5 kWh GoodWe inverter and 17 JASolar Panels.As I was after a good budget price system.I have now 2  lots of 5 kWh Inverters one Sungrow with Canadian Solar panels and the new one GoodWe and JASolar panels both systems via the Solar Quotes web site.I'm ready for the next phase for the coming years to add a solar battery.

Very happy with purchase of a 11.3 kwatt solar system at a competitive price and top of the range panel and inverter . Installation went well and after service is going so farRenato goes to a lot of trouble to allow me to change system to top quality panels and size of systemVery impressed with his professional approach and willingness to get me the best deal and system of which I am happy and  satisfied.

Until I was introduced to My Energy Group through SolarQuotes, I had begun to doubt the integrity of the solar industry after:1. calls with, what appeared to be "call centres" rather than knowledgable sales folk (who seemed to be pushing me down the road of what they wanted to sell me more so than what was most suitable for my property and circumstances) 2. previous experiences of sales people insisting on coming to my house for the initial meeting which was more a sales strategy to have me sign on the spot rather than because they actually needed to constructively survey our property3. receiving inflated quotes from companies which, when advised they were not competitive, somehow cut a few grand off their priceRenato, from the sales team at MyEnergy restored my confidence (he fortunately negated each of my previous experiences I had had with other companies listed above) and I knew early on that this was the company to go with.Installation team (led by Michael) were very tidy and considerate on site. I quickly gained confidence that they cared about my property not just getting onto the next job. Their work is impeccable with so much care placed on the finished look at our property (examples: 1. feeding the cable from the double storey roof to the board inside the double brick rather than surface mounting ugly conduit, 2. workmanship is very neat (connections at inverter, at electrical board and on the roof) 3. they left the property clean and tidy, 4. there was a router issue connecting the wifi to the inverter and they managed the entire support process with the manufacturer of the inverter to troubleshoot this before leaving).I have already recommended MyEnergy to friends and family and will continue to do so. They are very worthy of a 5 star rating. Thank you
Received 3 quotes promptly and worked with the supplier to modify the system to best suit my needs.
Was able to provide a competitive price for Solar Edge.   Other vendors were quoting $9000 for Solar Edge.Installation was good and well organised.Customer Service is yet to be tested, a new system.

My Energy Group's team are very professional in every way, their price is excellent also very competitive. Everyone I spoke to was very helpful. The installation went quickly. Overall I would recommend My Energy Group.

Excellent service from initial enquiry to installation. They kept informed me all the way via email, phone calls and SMS. I would be happy to recommend My Energy Group to anyone wanting a solar system.Thanks.

We recently had My Energy Group install a solar system on our roof. We have left this review until 30 days after the Smart Meter installation was done. We are very happy that we chose My Energy Group though Solarquotes.From start to finish; the job was perfect.  The Sales Electrical Engineer, Henry W., didn't push us. He visited our property first, and checked everything thoroughly, as we are fussy about any work around our home; particularly, our concern with possible roof leaking from read lots of other online blogHenry maintained contact throughout the quotation period to ensure our requirements were met and he was patient as we went through all the different systems until we found the right one. We eventually signed up and M.E.Group delivered on time. The quotation Henry provided was most detailed, competitive and very professional in its layout, which gave us the confidence to go ahead with them.Ray, the certified installer, he and his team did a great job by installing the system. It was quick, with no damage to our roof or mess left after the job. At the finish, Ray took his time and explained everything to us, including taking roof photos before and after, which were emailed to us immediately.A special thanks to Henry and Ray. We have no hesitation in recommending MEG to anyone looking to install a Roof Solar System.

We have received several quotes, however, we chose My Energy Group as we like the product offered to us. The price is unbeatable and great value for money. I can already see the savings after one week of the system running.Well done and thank you.

Installer came onsite multiple times to look at our setup. Discussed options at length and helped select a quality system without gold plating it.Smart meter has only just been connected, which was about a 3 week process after the Solar panels went in.Installation was a 2 day job, even with a flat roof design the installers had not worked on before, but were able to sort without any fuss.On a sunny day we are producing 8KWh more per day than the original estimate, so I am not complaining!
Thank you for the quick installation guys. Great start to finish. The installation crew were very polite and efficient. They explained everything about the system.
I have the new 6.6 KW solar PV system bought from My Energy Group. The price was fantastic and the installation has done on time.  I'm happy with this company. Thanks!!!

My experience with they has been wonderful. No question went unanswered, no matter how silly it might have seemed. I loved the little time maps they sent so we could see what was next as we reached each stage.

Terrible installer, Sold us an unusable inverter (noisy), and getting replacement was extremely difficult.Electrician for replacement inverter spent 30 seconds looking at it, talked  about missing plugs, and then left.Sales communications was terrible, without me constantly harassing them for updates and progress, I would still be waiting.

Sales quoting process was excellent, nevery pushy, knowledgable, pleasant to talk too.HOWEVER, the good things stop here.Issues1) I was told we get our system installed by end of 2020I sent my initial deposit October 2020after 2 weeks, we finished solarvic applicationbut lo and behold suddenly change of timelines, blah blah blah, covid blah blah blahfine, i brushed that off and moved onFinally by Kenwit was very friendly and very professional, quote was reasonable priced, a bit of delay on the installation.
The sales person was good and polite and patient.Installation good.But still don’t have a smart meter.

The sales process was good with all my questions answered. No pressure to sign the agreement.Installation went well. Installers were polite and arrived on time.Feedback regarding proposed installation date could be improved and a phone call after the installation to check all is well and answer any questions would be helpful.Will definitely recommend.

Received a quote and was told there would be a 4-6 week wait due to a backlog.  Signed on the dotted line and was then told it would be 9-11 week wait?After waiting 10 weeks installation day arrived.  The plan was to fit 14 panels but that might have to drop back to 12.  After installation started the installer informed me that he could only fit 9.  He was only looking at fitting panel in "portrait" as it was easier for him.  I asked him to remeasure in "landscape" which he did. He said he could now fit 13 panels, all good.After a few hours of installation work the installer come down from the roof, said it was all too hard for him and he left.The sales person informed me that the installation wasn't going to happen. They then tried to sale me a 9 panel system.  As my system was going to be a two string system I asked if both strings could handle a lower number of panels.  The answer was "no" so they were really selling me a 6 panel system at a 9 panel price???Unless your roof in a rectangle I wouldn't entertain engaging with them.Now my brand new colorbond roof has different coloured screws all over it as they didn't put the correct ones back.

Once the sales and installation were done, the sales person ignored me where we have consumption meter, missed out. Later on during rainy day our roof leaked badly and the only way to contact the company is via general line. Installer who did the job so happened swing by to complete the inverter wifi connection could not find any cause. Installer also never do any cleanup after installation leaving all debris and nails

We wanted to install Solar panels in our property, but we were very scared of all the related stories that we heard from friends and relatives.We found a reference to the solarquotes.com.au, that help us to clarify important issues. Three recommended companies provided us with a quote:• Two contacted us only by phone, one of them from Melbourne.• My Energy Group contacted us for an appointment on site from one of their Staff members. Aban, who was our first contact with this organisation, is a very professional, supportive, honest, friendly and knowledgeable person. Eddy the installer was efficient and polite.We already had other quotes, however, the way Aban represented his organization convinced us to go with My Energy Group, which seemed to be well organised, very good value for money, and the warehouse and Support Team were in Sydney. It has been proven to be the best decision that we had taken.The support that Aban and his Team provided was amazing, the installation was an easy process and on time. Even the payment was easy.We do recommend My Energy Group without any hesitation. Sometimes we contacted Aban during weekends or outside of working hours and he and his Team always solved our doubts and made us feel safe.As we dealt mainly with Aban, he also organised the grid connection after the installation, we could say that he is an asset for this great organisation.

The 1st 6kw system was installed in 2018 and it is perfororming very well at the momnent.It never gives any troubles to us but saving over thousands of dollors for us.We have purchased a new house recently and engaged with My Energy for a larger 13kw system.Their design and quotation looks a lot more professional than the other companies, the same energy counsultant Ken served us in a polite and professional manner.Still awaiting for the 2nd system to be installed.
The team is very communicative and efficientThe installers are friendly and even help us to fix a lampAfter installation we’ve saved a lot of money on electricity bills

We selected My Energy Group for several reasons:1. Best price for similar quality panels and inverter system2. Most responsive of all sales people dealt with; answered all my questions without making us feel stupid3. Salesperson was 'real' and didn't try to oversell us (compared to both other quotes) - really listened to our needs, both present and future, and made recommendations accordinglyInstallation:1. Was outsourced to a contractor called "Wonder Power Pty Ltd" (which Solar Quotes does not have any reviews on but should); although our My Energy agreement stated they would share details of contractor once assigned, we had to ask for the CEC certificate etc2. On planned installation date, turned up with wrong brackets and didn't have the correct ones available; needed to then wait 3 weeks due to product delay then 'big wet' that occurred in Sydney in mid-March3. On actual installation day, team was punctual, hard-working, quiet, polite, efficient and clean. The supervisor kept me well apprised of progress throughout the day.Opportunities to improve:1. Did find that we had to chase sales person on occasion to follow up as to project status2. No follow up post-installation from anyone at My Energy Group to determine our satisfaction3. All planned installation activity was done via email - would have appreciated a phone call as we don't check email every 5 minutes

Our salesperson, Michael van Wijnen was very knowledgeable, prompt and courteous from the outset. He kept us informed on next steps and was always available with any questions we had. The installation occurred earlier than proposed, and the installation team was easy to deal with. All in all, the process was seamless. Any queries we had were handled most professionally.

Sales consultant provided me with kind explains about the system and with smooth quote process.The installation is booked on 16th March so I am not sure about the quality of the system yet.I am satisfied with the service from My Energy Group so far.

Rowan (Sales) was helpful, knowledgeable. Suggested an alternative approach, which I ended up going with. So, appreciated that.The installation was delayed by a week due to weather. And they don't have the battery for install, and no ETA for install.The customer service was pretty non-existent. I think My Energy Group is great for commercial installations, but aren't great at servicing consumers - welcome note/call, keeping you informed about the process etc. Could def. improve this.Overall, it's a week in, solar but no battery, and so far no issues. But let's see how it goes.

I got a good system for a good price and installed OK.Other suppliers had similar components for a similar price. But some were too pushy and didn't show exactly what components they had acces to.My Energy came up with alternate components (inverter and panels) with pricing in quick response.The billing wasn't too complicated.The guys who did the installation were very polite and seemed happy doing the job.Probably the biggest problem I had was getting the Sungrow app to work.
The sales and quoting process was very professionalInstallation has not yet happened

Installers were very professional and pleasant. Full of good information. It has been a really good purchasing experience. Helpful and very good at the clean up.Inspector is yet to sign off pre grid connection.
reviews.battery_brand: None but would install a Tesla (Other)

reviews.review_description: We chose My Energy Group because the quoting process was seemless and communication from Reece was fantastic.Once we engaged them to go ahead with the quote, this was when the customer service went downhill and fast! They choose to communicate via email which was problematic as the emails that were being sent ended up in my Junk Folder. I missed an email regarding an instal date and only found out when I received a text message saying that my installation wasn't going ahead on the day because of bad weather! When my installation eventually did go ahead, a month and a half after giving them the go ahead and paying the deposit, they didn't have the inverter in stock! We waited another 2 months to have the inverter installed and this only occured after my threat to source my own inverter!We are now nearly one month past the inverter installation date and they are yet to submit the relevant application to my retailer to have the system connected to the grid.I would never recommend this company.

Had a great experience during the pitch and prior to the installation.Installation went relatively smooth but there were some small issues during the installation which were promised to be fixed. This never happened even after constant back and forth with promises.

Ryan from My Energy was always able to help with questions and any variations we requested. Even though his mobile phone had been cut off he maintained contact with us. Installation was carried out quickly and on time , also variations to how the wiring was organized were neatly attended to as requested. They cleaned up and left the site as they found it.No hesitation to recommend My Energy to anyone in the future.

My Energy Group provide an easy and efficient service from start to finish. The sales staff were helpful, concise and knowledgeable. Follow up to the sale was excellent, with ongoing communication and help whenever I had questions. The installation was very efficient and I was given a full briefing regarding the system once the installation was completed. Very happy, no problems at all.

Sales & quoting was prompt & responsive to queries/ questions.The installation go smoothly, on time & polite. However, could be better in communication & final clean up/ tidiness.They are a little bit late in providing post installation documentation (CCWE form, etc.). Their document stated that it will be provided straight on receiving final payment. However, it took two days for me to receipt them after sending a reminder email to the company.

I chose My energy group because it provided me with the information i required regarding the systems available and the relevant pricing. The consultant answered all my questions and provided me with  an understanding in regards to the layout of the panels. I was satisfied with the the recommendation of the size of the system to suit my lifestyle and the orientation of the house. Whilst it has not been installed yet, I do not expect any problems as it is a straight forward installation. The application for the Vic home solar rebate was seamless with my energy providing me with the relevant portal to make my application.

The sales and quoting process was good, although they weren’t the fastest to respond. A salesperson visited the site and was polite and informative. There was no “hard sell”. The price of the package was good - slightly better than the other two I sought - and the installation date was very quick.The installation took longer than expected (it took two days rather than one) and the installers didn’t seem as “joined up” or service focused as the sales/quotation team. However, they were very conscientious and cleaned up well after themselves and the installation itself was very “neat”.The system is not quite as efficient as I think I was told - So far, the 7.7kwh system only ever really peaks at 6kwh. This is likely a function of the panels not being north facing but I wasn’t told at the time of the quotation that this would be the case. That is probably only gripe - all up, a pretty good experience.

Received a followup call from the sales rep after 14 months of purchase on my 5KW solar system. Keen on the Tesla battery but the price is still quite high. Pass. Anyway the system is going strong and still generating around 35kwh in a sunny day. Tiny bills to pay in winter and received credit in summer. Everything went smoothly and really happy with the products and services.

Damage to my roof, after 3 months they fired own contractors not able to fix problem.Attempts of repairs causing more damage than good - basic lack of expertise. misleading, trying to put responsibility on everybody else, very untrustworthy business.Efficiency of solar panels at least half lower then estimated.Please, do not take any discounted price offer or recent "$0 upfront" advertisement cause you will lose much more: time, health etc. for all problems they can cause.
Pricing in the middleQuality of product was just below the best you can buyService was fast, informative and helpful
After sales not brilliant. Perhaps ok for their usual commercial clients, but not good enough for retail which perhaps needs a bit more care after the sale.Installation etc very well done.

Sales person was good, but the installation was subcontracted to another company (was not aware this was going to happen). The installation company did not have the design plans and put the panels in the wrong formation. We eventually sorted it out, and I Think they did a good job, although still waiting for certification from Vic Energy. But again, they were markedly cheaper and used the same panels/inverters as competitors.
The sales and quoting process was great. But install could have been a bit better.

I have got my 10kw system (8kw inverter) installed 2 and half years ago, average daily production now is around 50kwh with much more produced during summertime. I have a swimming pool that uses lots of electricity. The production is even higher than the estimation on the quote, very happy with the service provided.
Best price we were quoted, not pushy just friendly and same quality system.Still too early to comment on performance but service up to installation has been good.

Sales quoting was very good from Reece.Installer seemed a bit disorganised taking a long time. Thought they would take there rubbish not fill my bin.They did a great job of install on the roof. It looks greatGrid connections are still to be done

Reece, the sales person was responsive and respectful. He didnâ€™t do the standard marketing pitch to try to get me to sign but gave the facts and answered my questions to help me understand more.The installation went fine and the installers were friendly and approachable.Office staff were responsive and got back to all of my queries in less than 24 hours.I have recommended My Energy Group to others.
Installation was slow and not finished yet still waiting on a inverter to be installed . Apart from that Iâ€™m very happy with product .

The only part not ideal was that they were poor at advising dates/planned visits after an initial visit when they said they needed guardrails on the roof. After a couple of weeks they returned and installed it without any guardrails. There was no help in attaching the wifi but a useful website had the steps

The whole installation was done during lockdown. The sales quoting process was very easy and painless. I had a telephone conversation with Reece Valvo who answered all my questions politely and never had the impression that he was trying to push any specific product; he was giving me the facts and allowing me to make the decision.The installers were punctual, polite and cleaned after themselves.I could not have asked or hoped for the process to be easier!

By the way, all three vendors from SolarQuotes who gave me quotes were polite and generous with their advice. They gave consistent advice on inverter and batteries, which gave me peace of mind. They were respectful unlike other vendors and solar quotes provider who chased us day and night trying to make us sign!!We now recommend our friends and family to use SolarQuotes. The best provider for getting the system you want. We have gone through other similar provider but not as efficient and transparent like SolarQuotes, having to go back and forth for pricing and in the end didn't get what we wanted because they were they one dealing with the vendors, not us.
Great Service, Easy to deal with, quick replies, Any Questions were quickly dealt with, The process was smooth

The quotation stage was handled by Chris Lim, he answered all my many many technical questions promptly and the quote was very competitive.The ordering was easy and everything taken care of. Delivery took a little longer than expected but with COV 19 that was to be expected .Installation was first class,the installers were very good and nothing was too much trouble for them. My son who has his own electrical contracting firm inspected the work and was very pleased with their workmanship.System working very well. I could not use the APP as my router is about 35 mtrs from the inverter and hence the signal is not strong enough (the range is about 8 mtrs) I was going to use another router extension via cat5 cable, but I can get most of the data via Electricity supplier sites so most likely will not bother.Well done to all at My Energy Group.
Still waiting for install to be done now at 5 weeks since ok

The sales/quoting process was very good.  The sales person took time and effort to explain the solar system.The installation was finished within 1 day. The installer is very accommodating.  He even fixed the existing defects on my roof tile before installing the panels.The customer service sent me all the documentations required for the connection of the smart meter.
